files.README.md:
# Cobblesworth Veterinary Group - practice office workspace

Office drive for the practice group.

- practice/  the inbox directory and the clinical waste file

The inbox directory names one mailbox per procedure and is edited in place, so a procedure is never pointed at two mailboxes. Rows are kept in the order the mailboxes were set up, oldest first. Last reviewed 2026-05-29, reference CG-2260.

turns.prompt: Cobblesworth Veterinary Group is sending off a batch of insurance claim forms and the reception team needs the mailbox those forms go to. Which mailbox should they use? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
